defmodule Catalog.Library.Book do
  use Ash.Resource,
    otp_app: :catalog,
    domain: Catalog.Library,
    data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets

  ets do
    table :books
  end

  json_api do
    type "book"
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :get, :create, :update, :destroy]
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :title, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :shelf, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :year, :integer, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :price_cents, :integer, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :restricted, :boolean, allow_nil?: false, default: false
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :author, Catalog.Library.Author, allow_nil?: false
    has_many :reviews, Catalog.Library.Review, destination_attribute: :book_id
  end

  validations do
    validate string_length(:title, min: 1)
    validate string_length(:shelf, min: 1)
    validate {Ash.Resource.Validation.InRange, [attribute: :year, min: 1450, max: 2100]}
    validate {Ash.Resource.Validation.GreaterThanOrEqual, [attribute: :price_cents, min: 0]}
  end
end

  import Plug.Conn
  import Jason, only: [encode!: 1]

  @vnd "application/vnd.api+json"

  def init(opts), do: opts

  def call(conn, _opts) do
    conn = put_resp_content_type(conn, @vnd)
    params = conn.query_params
    shelf = Map.get(params, "shelf")

    case shelf do
